items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: My Grand-dad was the head of a committee that bought up a gang of instruments and gave them to the high schools.

ctx.x: TELL ME ABOUT YOUR FAMILY AND ALL. TELL ME ABOUT GROWING UP IN LITTLE ROCK. WHAT GOT YOU STARTED ON MUSIC?

My Grand-dad was the head of a committee that bought up a gang of instruments and gave them to the high schools. By my grand-dad being the head of the committee I had my choice of any instrument I wanted in the band. So, I choose the trombone as a little kid. In fact, I have a little picture of me when I first started. I was only playing about two or three months. That's how I started---in the high school band.
